Open Engineering Plan • v0.5.0 Shipped → v1.0.0 GA Dogfood Cutover

Public Engineering Roadmap

RaggieSoft Installer Studio is built in the open as original, zero-dependency native Win32 C++20 software for Windows 11 x64 and ARM64. Our v1.0.0 GA North Star is clear and practical: reaching the exact point where 100% of RaggieSoft's own Windows applications, classic VB6 utilities (StoreTrainer), interactive novels, and supporter audio archives are packaged, signed, updated, and distributed exclusively with Installer Studio—while permanently keeping Community Edition at 100% technical feature parity with Premier Edition.

Shipped Today • v0.1.0 – v0.5.0

Foundation Shipped in Technical Preview

  • 10 Selectable Wizard Styles, Classic Setup Types & WCAG Auto-Contrast (v0.5.0): Selectable era-spanning [UI] WizardLayout styles (including fullscreenteal 1995 ACME #008080 Teal & fullscreenblue #000080 Cobalt washes, wizard95, wizard97, aerowizard, fluentmica, oneclick, passivetoast, and autorun16x9), classic Typical / Compact / Complete / Custom & [SetupType.*] presets, [Billboard.*] slides, and one-click WCAG 2.2 AA Auto-Contrast.
  • Microsoft Azure Artifact Signing & ARM64 /dlib Dispatch (v0.4.5): Dual-layer Public Trust Authenticode signing across every inner C++20 binary, .msi database, and Universal Setup.exe—backed by automatic PE Machine matching for Azure.CodeSigning.Dlib.dll on Windows 11 ARM64 workstations and ImageRemoveCertificate pre-signed template stripping.
  • Plain-English Feature Inclusion Tiers (v0.4.4): Replaced cryptic numeric Windows Installer InstallLevel inputs with human-friendly Included In tiers (Minimal / Compact, Typical / Express, Complete Only, and Hidden) across the Visual IDE and .rsip grammar.
  • CPU-Aware Smart Web Stub & Combined Offline Universal EXE (v0.4.3): Eliminates separate x64 vs. ARM64 download confusion via a compact 64-bit universal outer launcher that pierces Windows 11 Prism emulation through IsWow64Process2 to download or unpack the genuine native silicon installer with SHA-256 verification.
  • 12-View Tree-First Win32 C++20 Visual IDE, Live Dark Mode & Native F1 Help (v0.3.0–v0.4.2): Categorized sidebar tree, dedicated Features and RegEdit-style Registry trees, custom-subclassed Dark Mode push buttons and checkboxes flipping live on WM_SETTINGCHANGE(ImmersiveColorSet), zero-dependency RaggieSoftHelp.exe, Pre-MSI [Prerequisite.*] runtimes, and 64-bit .MSM merging.
Explore Live v0.5.0 Screenshots Read Full v0.1.0 → v0.5.0 Changelog
Shipped in v0.5.0

10 Wizard Layout Variations, Classic & Custom Setup Types & WCAG Contrast Enforcer

  • Classic & Modern Wizard Geometries ([UI] WizardLayout): Includes Wizard95 (164px sunken left graphic rail across all steps), Wizard97, AeroWizard, FluentMica, OneClickSplash, PassiveToast, FullScreenBlue, FullScreenTeal, and Autorun16x9.
  • Classic Windows 95 & Author-Defined Setup Types ([SetupType.<Id>]): Built-in Typical / Compact / Complete / Custom or modern Express / Compact / Custom presets plus repeatable custom publisher Setup Types.
  • Windows Contrast Theme Override & Live WCAG 2.2 AA Contrast Enforcer: Honors SPI_GETHIGHCONTRAST automatically and validates custom brand hex colors via RSW055 in instbuild.exe --validate.
Target v0.6.0 • Next Up

SFX .EXE Builder, Multi-Volume Disk Spanning, Loose Source Media (msiexec /a), .rswpak Packs & Multi-Engine Suites

  • Lightweight Self-Extracting Archive .EXE Builder (PackageKind = sfx): Turn any folder or .zip archive into a zero-dependency, Dark-Mode-aware LZMS self-extracting .exe with optional PostExtractRun or PostExtractOpen.
  • Multi-Volume Disk Spanning, Uncompressed Loose Source Media & Administrative Installs (msiexec.exe /a): Split multi-gigabyte distributions across numbered external CAB1..CABN.cab volumes, publish uncompressed side-by-side source trees supporting Run from Media and Run from Network, and support msiexec.exe /a network extractions.
  • Granular On-Demand Feature Packs (.rswpak) & Multi-Engine Suites (PackageKind = suite): Chain transactional .msi desktop apps alongside multi-gigabyte Engine = native book and music libraries.
Target v0.7.0

From-Scratch Dual Dialog Builders (C++ & Raw MSI.DLL) & RsDialog Scripting

  • From-Scratch C++ & Raw 370×270 MSI.DLL Dialog Designers: Blank-canvas WYSIWYG editors for building custom wizard pages in both SetupWizard.exe ([Dialog.*]) and standalone msiexec SQL tables ([MsiDialog.*] / [MsiControl.*]).
  • RsDialog Standard Library + .rssc Event Hooks: Lifecycle hooks paired with procedural RsWelcome(), RsLicense(), RsSetupType(), RsFeatureTree(), RsAskDestPath(), and RsFinish() dialogs.
Target v0.8.0

Solution & Legacy Project Importers (.slnx, VB6 .vbp Reg-Free COM & .msi) + Restart Manager

  • Visual Studio .slnx / .csproj / .vcxproj & VB6 .vbp Importers: One-click runtime detection plus Reg-Free COM side-by-side manifest generation for classic VB6 utilities like StoreTrainer.
  • .msi Decompiler & Windows Restart Manager (Rstrtmgr.dll): Import existing .msi databases into .rsip projects and gracefully close running app processes during upgrades.
Target v0.9.0

Authenticode & Azure Artifact Signing Studio, White-Label RsUpdate.exe & Guided .MSP Servicing

  • Interactive Signing Studio & White-Label RsUpdate.exe: Certificate store picker, Azure Artifact Signing tester, Dual-Layer WinVerifyTrust check, and guided binary-delta .msp servicing.
Target v1.0.0 GA & v1.1+

v1.0.0 GA Production Dogfood Cutover & Post-1.0 Enterprise Expansion

  • v1.0.0 GA: First-party GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps tasks, --emit-winget, and 100% RaggieSoft production cutover across all Windows apps, interactive novels, and audio archives.
  • v1.1+ Post-1.0: Disposable Windows 11 Pro Sandbox (.wsb) Setup Capture, Visual Studio .vsix, Windows Services/Firewall/Config Patchers, in-process .MSIXBUNDLE (AppxPackaging.dll), 20+ language I18N + RTL, and SPDX / CycloneDX --emit-sbom.
